comments.body: Pinning this — the four screens Maya deleted are exactly the ones our support queue kept asking about. Correlation isn't causation, but it's a strong hint.
That matches what we saw. Ticket volume on onboarding dropped about 40% in the first fortnight.
Did you A/B this or ship it straight to everyone? Curious how confident you were before rollout.
The bit about deleting screens rather than redesigning them is the part I keep coming back to. We spend so much effort making bad steps prettier.
Trying this on our KYC flow next week.
This one failed to send — the retry path stays visible instead of the comment vanishing.
